text: {"label":"Resurgence of Previously Extinguished Behavior","definition":"Basic, translational, and applied research on resurgence: the return of an extinguished response when alternative reinforcement is reduced or removed. It covers effects of reinforcer parameters, response effort, and treatment duration, plus mitigation strategies.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on resurgence, rather than relapse in general (renewal, reinstatement), designing alternative-reinforcement treatments for problem behavior, or extinction bursts and resistance to extinction."}
